roles.name: Super user
roles.description: This role provides all application permissions.

roles.name: TKB_ACCOUNTING_MAKER
roles.description: Responsible for initiating accounting transactions and journal entries, subject to approval by authorized accounting checkers.

roles.name: TKB_ACCOUNTING_CHECKER
roles.description: Responsible for reviewing, approving, or rejecting accounting transactions initiated by authorized makers, ensuring accuracy and compliance with internal accounting controls.

roles.name: TKB_ACCOUNTING_MANAGER
roles.description: Responsible for overseeing accounting operations, managing authorized accounting configurations, monitoring financial transactions, and ensuring compliance with internal financial controls.

roles.name: TKB_SAVINGS_OFFICER
roles.description: Responsible for initiating and maintaining authorized customer savings operations.

roles.name: TKB_SAVINGS_SUPERVISOR
roles.description: Responsible for reviewing and supervising customer deposit operations.

roles.name: TKB_LOAN_OFFICER
roles.description: Responsible for initiating loan applications and maintaining assigned loan portfolios.

roles.name: TKB_LOAN_APPROVER
roles.description: Responsible for reviewing and approving eligible loan applications within assigned authority.

roles.name: TKB_TELLER_CASHIER
roles.description: Responsible for authorized cash transactions and teller operations.

roles.name: TKB_CASH_SUPERVISOR
roles.description: Responsible for supervising teller cash management and cash allocation activities.

roles.name: TKB_CUSTOMER_SERVICE
roles.description: Responsible for creating and maintaining customer information within assigned authority.

roles.name: TKB_RISK_VIEWER
roles.description: Responsible for reviewing financial and portfolio information for risk monitoring purposes.

roles.name: TKB_IT_SUPPORT
roles.description: Responsible for viewing system information and supporting authorized operational activities.

roles.name: TKB_USER_ADMIN
roles.description: Responsible for creating and maintaining application users and assigning authorized roles.

roles.name: TKB_AUDITOR_READONLY
roles.description: Responsible for independently reviewing accounting and operational records without modification rights.
